title: Tenancy Boundary Spec
description: Input shape for scripts/tenancy_boundary_audit.mjs — a normalized description of a product's local-first account/tenancy model and its cloud data-boundary consent design.

features.description: Every user-facing feature that either gates on identity or moves data across a scope tier. An empty array is treated as unsafe (fail closed), not as "nothing to report."

requiresIdentity.description: True if this feature cannot function without a signed-in account or paired device (passkey, device pairing, etc.).

hasLocalOnlyPath.description: True if the feature (or a reduced equivalent of it) works with zero account, zero pairing, zero cloud dependency.

scopeTier.description: The tenancy scope tier this feature's data lives in. "private" never leaves the device; repo/team/public all cross the local/cloud data boundary.

crossesTierWithConsentScreen.description: True if, before this feature's data first moves from the private/local tier into scopeTier, the user sees and affirmatively passes an explicit data-boundary consent screen.

uploadsNothingTestable.description: True only if the "local-only mode uploads nothing" claim is backed by a runtime-verifiable check (e.g. a network-egress assertion), not merely documented.

perTierSupported.description: True only if export and delete controls are implemented and verified for every scope tier a user's data can land in.

scopeLadderOrdered.description: True if the private -> repo -> team -> public scope ladder is declared once, in order, as a single source of truth that role/consent logic derives from.
